0b593f5f25fe8621cfa28943c44099a16503e13b.rationale: Production coordinate (epic_coordination.coordinate, invoked through epic_workspace main) judges each OpenHands worker under its lifecycle lock. It uses digests of checkout content, test cache, validation and PR state; failure-signature changes are excluded from progress. judge_item records change_approach, then bounded_diagnosis, then handoff, then a no_progress_exhausted stop, each bounded by stall_limit and the 60s backoff and tagged to the assignment. A worker blocker file with no non-builder receipt yields repair_technical_dependency, routed to issue-maintenance-change-control with the GitHub write kept as a coordinator obligation. read_issue_authority/authority_for accept only live lifecycle labels plus a matching OWNER-associated receipt. Human-action or non-builder-owned receipts become authority_stop with a stop_conditions record and no session contact. Other items continue and appear in independent_work_continues. The named test exercises all of this through repeated CLI passes and asserts exact decision and stop records, peers progressing and no lifecycle or publication side effects. The apply-path tests show directives reach only the current conversation and are never re-posted.

limitations: Real model behaviour and live coordinator runs depend on the external runtime receipt, which uses simulated authority; I did not re-run it.

scope_assessment.acceptance: The #6619 outcome is implemented in the production coordinate entrypoint (epic_workspace main -> epic_coordination.coordinate). Progress is judged from checkout content, pytest last-failed cache, validation_status and live PR state. Heartbeats, event counts, narration and error-text churn are explicitly excluded. Equivalent evidence climbs a bounded ladder (change_approach, bounded_diagnosis with helper budget 0, handoff, then a no_progress_exhausted stop) recorded in existing dispatch_decisions/stop_conditions. A worker-declared blocker with no non-builder receipt is routed to issue-maintenance-change-control as repair_technical_dependency. A GitHub OWNER-associated blocker-action receipt matching live lifecycle labels is preserved as authority_stop with no worker contact, while peers keep being judged. Optional --apply delivery is reserved before the effect, bound to the assignment tuple and endpoint, reconciled by marker and never re-posted. The composed #6618 PR-cycle repairs (stop-generation fencing, exact-ID verifier lifecycle, merge-intent retention, claimant chronology, cross-branch path refusal) fail closed on unknown ownership or effects.
limitations: Unit tests use simulated Docker, agent-server and GitHub boundaries. Real model reaction and the actual owned coordinator runs rely on the cited runtime receipt (issuecomment-6872271808), which I did not independently re-run. Its authority input was explicitly SIMULATED.
Current-head CI for 6018f93 was not observed by this review; the PR body says it remains required.
coordinate is a one-shot pass invoked by the trusted controller, not a disconnect-safe standing coordinator; that remains #6618.

Applied vs non-applied passes read the PR part from different sources (live inventory digest vs run-state mapping). With an open PR on the worker branch, alternating modes would register as false progress and reset the ladder.

Records written before this change without stop IDs (stopped workers, authorized takeovers, review stop intents) now refuse takeover or review until a fresh worker-stop or trusted reconciliation. This is fail-closed, but it is an upgrade step to plan before activating the candidate.
agent_worktree now permanently refuses re-registering a path for a different branch, because records are never deleted. A replacement path is required; this is documented in GIT_HYGIENE.
Known deferred P2s KD-4B9E44394285 (stale replay after new evidence) and KD-E936BAA5DA07 (reservation stranded by port-lock contention) remain open under #6618 operating limits.
scope_assessment.verify_coverage: The named Verify test drives seven workers through repeated real CLI coordinate passes over a real run-state file and real git checkouts. The engine, agent-server and GitHub are simulated stand-ins. It asserts the recorded change_approach/bounded_diagnosis/handoff/exhausted-stop sequence, one repair decision with the owning workflow, a preserved authority stop with its receipt fields, unknown-evidence items that never advance, peers listed in independent_work_continues, and no start, stop or publication side effects. Directive delivery, replay, lost-reply, 429, assignment and endpoint fencing and authority-at-send-boundary are covered by the other tests in that file and in the assignment_fence/regressions files, which pass. PR-cycle, stop-lineage and reclaim targets pass (155 for the requested targets; 182 for the additional coordination/OpenHands/isolation/agent_worktree files).
